'''November 2001 Berkeley tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Berkley, CA on 18 November 2001. It is known from Mike Lynch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3136">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-would-the-real-tr-please-stand-upd3136/ would-the-real-tr-please-stand-up], DeckTech (Mike "Hangmann" Lynch, 2 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-would-the-real-tr-please-stand-upd3136/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Berkley, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
